quote_model.spread: ASK - BID of the same event tick

commission.formula: VolumeLots * ContractSize * OpeningPrice * CommissionRatePercent / 100, once on the opening transaction

slippage.direction: Long entry Ask+E; Short entry Bid-E; Long exit Bid-X; Short exit Ask+X

latency.rule: execute on the first executable tick at or after decision time + delay

swap.rule: recorded from actual deal/position swap when it occurs; never forecast at entry

entry_cost_gate.violation: observed value strictly greater than the frozen maximum

position_sizing.worst_case_loss_per_lot: loss(ExecEntry -> SL -/+ DeclaredRiskExecutionBufferPoints) + opening commission per lot
position_sizing.economics: OrderCalcProfit / OrderCalcMargin; OrderCheck for live execution validity
position_sizing.volume_rounding: down to SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP; capped at SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX; below SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN = reject
position_sizing.margin: volume reduced (rounded down) to available margin; below minimum = reject
position_sizing.research_mid_stop: sizing SPEC-INCOMPLETE until the stop-execution spread buffer is declared (roadmap 4.5)

risk_admission.admission_formula: ProjectedWorstCaseEquity = CurrentEquity - sum(IncrementalWorstCaseOpenLoss) - NewTradeWorstCaseLoss >= StartOfBrokerDayEquity - MaxDailyLossR * DayRiskUnitCurrency
risk_admission.gate_precedence: ACCOUNT_RULE_BREACH, ACCOUNT_RULE_NEAR_BREACH, DAILY_PROFIT_TARGET, MAX_CONCURRENT, DIRECTIONAL_CAP, DAILY_LOSS_FLOOR, AGGREGATE_CEILING, DIRECTIONAL_CEILING
risk_admission.floating_loss_policy: admission guard only; never force-closes open positions
